event.updated: updated {count, plural, one {one field} other {# fields}}

list.title: Work items
list.intro: Work that you delegated to a person, an agent, or the built-in AI, or that was delegated to you. A work item remains even if an AI run fails, and can wait for someone.
list.loadFailed: The work items could not be loaded.
list.emptyDescription: Create a work item when something needs to be done that takes longer than a quick reply in chat.
list.truncated: There are more work items than shown here. Narrow down the selection with the filters.

dialog.description: Describe what should be achieved and how you’ll know it’s done.
dialog.goalPlaceholder: What should exist at the end? What is known, what isn’t?
dialog.criteriaHint: One criterion per line. Criteria already met stay met as long as their text doesn’t change.

detail.loadFailed: The work item couldn’t be loaded.
detail.reasonLabel: What is this work item waiting for?
detail.reasonPlaceholder: For example: Archive access is missing
detail.notePlaceholder: Progress update, question, or note for the next attempt

startRun.title: Start AI run
startRun.description: The built-in AI receives the work item with its goal, criteria, and context pages in a dedicated conversation, and records its result on the work item. A work item without an assignee will be assigned to the AI.
startRun.instructionsPlaceholder: For example: Look at the attachments first.

deleteDialog.title: Delete work item permanently?
deleteDialog.description: The work item and its history will be permanently deleted. Subtasks will remain as standalone items, and AI runs will still count toward usage. If the work item is simply no longer needed, set it to “Cancelled” instead.
